input.command:
cd /task/screenshots && for f in *.png; do
  name="${f%.png}"
  height=$(ffprobe -v error -show_entries stream=height -of default=noprint_wrappers=1:nokey=1 "$f")
  chunk=$(( (height + 2) / 3 ))
  # Split into 3 sections (top, mid, bot) at 1200px wide for inspection
  ffmpeg -y -i "$f" -vf "crop=1440:${chunk}:0:0,scale=1100:-1" "/tmp/screens/${name}_1top.png" 2>/dev/null
  ffmpeg -y -i "$f" -vf "crop=1440:${chunk}:0:${chunk},scale=1100:-1" "/tmp/screens/${name}_2mid.png" 2>/dev/null
  ffmpeg -y -i "$f" -vf "crop=1440:${chunk}:0:$((chunk*2)),scale=1100:-1" "/tmp/screens/${name}_3bot.png" 2>/dev/null
done && ls -la /tmp/screens/ | head -30

mkdir -p /tmp/frames && for f in /task/screenrecordings/*.mp4; do
  name=$(basename "$f" .mp4)
  duration=$(ffprobe -v error -show_entries format=duration -of default=noprint_wrappers=1:nokey=1 "$f")
  echo "=== $name (${duration}s) ==="
  # Extract a couple frames near the start to look at initial animation
  ffmpeg -y -ss 0 -i "$f" -frames:v 1 -vf "scale=900:-1" "/tmp/frames/${name}_t0.png" 2>/dev/null
  ffmpeg -y -ss 0.5 -i "$f" -frames:v 1 -vf "scale=900:-1" "/tmp/frames/${name}_t05.png" 2>/dev/null
  ffmpeg -y -ss 1.5 -i "$f" -frames:v 1 -vf "scale=900:-1" "/tmp/frames/${name}_t15.png" 2>/dev/null
done && ls /tmp/frames/

All five pages are written. Here's what I built:

- **home.html** — sticky nav, gradient hero with staged fade-in reveal, search bar, scrolling category chips, featured/weekend event cards with gradient artwork and date chips, animated map block with pulsing markers, "New on Blockparty" list, popular organizers row, navy footer.
- **explore.html** — search/list-map toggle, sticky filters sidebar (date chips, category checkboxes, price chips, distance slider), 12-card event grid, full-width map with cluster markers and a preview card, paginator.
- **event.html** — gradient hero with diagonal sheen and category chip, action bar with date/location/organizer/follow/CTA, two-column body with about/included/schedule (dashed timeline)/location map/who's-going avatar grid, sticky ticket sidebar with sold-out/active/VIP states.
- **create.html** — page heading, 4-step stepper, three filled-in form cards (Basics, Tickets, Media with dashed upload zone), step 4 mini-map, sticky live-preview card with publish/draft buttons and pro tip.
- **organizer.html** — gradient banner with floating music notes, oversized avatar overlapping into stats card (4 stats), tabs row, upcoming events 4-col grid, past events list with capacity bars and SOLD OUT/NEAR FULL pills, where-they-host map + tags, 3-up reviews grid, footer.

Shared design language (Nunito font, gradient brand mark, orange CTAs, soft tinted backgrounds, 18px rounded cards, fade-up reveal animation, pulsing map markers) is consistent across all pages.
